edges.reason: msg.sender is the _msgSender used to set _taxWallet and initial supply in the constructor.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from parameter.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender consuming the allowance.
manualSend is public with no onlyOwner, so any msg.sender can trigger the ETH payout.
manualSwap is public with no onlyOwner, so any msg.sender can force a token swap.
updateTax is public with no onlyOwner, so any msg.sender can drain contract ETH to the fee wallet.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidity deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender before increaseWallet executes.
onlyOwner gates increaseTx on the stored _owner.
onlyOwner gates addLiquidity on the stored _owner.
onlyOwner gates createPair on the stored _owner.
Constructor initializes _tTotal supply.
Constructor sets the initial tax fee.
Constructor assigns the payable tax wallet.
Constructor assigns the Uniswap router address.
_maxWallet is derived from _tTotal.
_maxTxAmount is derived from _tTotal.
_taxFee is passed as taxRate into _tokenTransfer for fee arithmetic.
_taxWallet is the destination of the ETH sent by sendETHToFee.
_transfer reads _balance for the contract token balance and recipient checks.
manualSwap reads the contract token balance from _balance.
transferFrom reads and subtracts from the _allowances mapping.
approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer enforces _maxWallet on recipient balances.
_transfer enforces _maxTxAmount on pair transfers.
_transfer compares from/to against _pair.
_inSwap guard blocks nested swap execution in _transfer.
_swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee for fee and limit exemptions.
_transfer reads and later mutates balances held in _balance.
_transfer performs an external swap through swapTokensForEth before _tokenTransfer updates balances.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer delegates the actual balance update to _tokenTransfer.
transfer invokes _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _transfer.
swapTokensForEth makes the external router swap call, handing control outside the contract.
The external router call can re-enter _transfer before the sender balance is decremented.
swapTokensForEth queries WETH and routes the swap through _uniswap.
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH value transfer to the tax wallet.
The ETH transfer to _taxWallet is an external call that can re-enter token logic.
Unrestricted manualSend calls sendETHToFee, exposing fee payouts to anyone.
Unrestricted manualSwap calls swapTokensForEth, letting anyone trigger swaps.
Unrestricted updateTax calls sendETHToFee, letting anyone drain contract ETH.
addLiquidity forwards ETH through the _uniswap router.
createPair uses _uniswap factory and WETH.
addLiquidity performs the payable external addLiquidityETH call.
createPair performs the external factory createPair call and pair approval.
addLiquidity sets _canTrade to true.
addLiquidity sets _swapEnabled to true.
createPair stores the created pair in _pair.
increaseWallet overwrites _maxWallet with the new amount.
increaseTx overwrites _maxTxAmount with the new amount.
_tokenTransfer mutates sender, recipient and contract entries of _balance.
_tokenTransfer performs multiplication, division and subtraction on amounts when computing tax.
receive() accepts ETH, increasing the contract balance later paid out.

normalization_plan.reason: The from address parameter only exists to feed the internal _transfer call.
The to address parameter only exists to feed the internal _transfer call.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the internal _transfer call.
tokenAmount is consumed entirely inside swapTokensForEth.
amount is consumed entirely inside sendETHToFee.
amount is consumed entirely inside increaseWallet.
amount is consumed entirely inside the public transfer function.
recipient is consumed entirely inside the public transfer function.
Local balance snapshot is used only for the auto-swap branch of _transfer.
Local ETH snapshot is used only for the threshold check in _transfer.
The path array is constructed solely for the router call in swapTokensForEth.
